spans.s:
लोच्^1 (ऋ, ङ) लोचते 10.
d. To see;
to view. (क) लोचयति 10.
a. To
speak, to shine. With आ to in-
vestigate, to consider.
[1] Correction submitted by jim funderburk on 20200321. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/201.

लोचक (कः) 1.
m. A lump of flesh
or meat; pupil of the eye; sti-
bium; wrinkled eye-brow; or-
nament of the forehead; bow;
string; folly; slough of a snake.
